text: ① 欧股盘前 阿斯麦控股发布业绩报告； ② 13:30 英国央行行长贝利在曼谷讲话； ③ 14:00 英国央行首席经济学家Huw Pill讲话； ④ 16:00 国际能源署（IEA）公布月度原油市场报告，欧洲央行执委Elderson在法兰克福讲话； ⑤ 16:30 欧洲央行行长拉加德谈论欧洲的数字未来，欧洲央行管委Álvaro Santos Pereira在曼谷讲话； ⑥ 17:20 欧洲央行管委Escriva、管委Makhlouf在曼谷举办的国际金融协会（IIF）活动上讲话； ⑦ 17:40 美联储理事、负责金融监管事务的副主席鲍曼在曼谷IMF年会场合
text_en: 1. Pre-European-market: ASML Holding releases its earnings report; 2. 13:30 Bank of England Governor Bailey speaks in Bangkok; 3. 14:00 Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill speaks; 4. 16:00 the International Energy Agency (IEA) releases its monthly oil market report, and ECB Executive Board member Elderson speaks in Frankfurt; 5. 16:30 ECB President Lagarde discusses Europe's digital future, and ECB Governing Council member Álvaro Santos Pereira speaks in Bangkok; 6. 17:20 ECB Governing Council members Escriva and Makhlouf speak at an Institute of International Finance (IIF) event held in Bangkok; 7. 17:40 Federal Reserve Governor and Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman speaks on the occasion of the IMF annual meetings in Bangkok.
